name: Big5-HCD
description: Personality-aware Human-Computer Dialogue (HCD) systems are critical for enabling personalized interactions. However, to the best of our knowledge, existing HCD benchmarks lack explicit personality trait annotations, creating a fundamental barrier to developing robust personality-aware HCD systems. To address this, we introduce Big5-HCD, the first HCD benchmark with fine-grained Big Five personality annotations. This benchmark was derived from RealPersonaChat—a Human-Human Dialogue (HHD) benchmark—through a four-stage semi-supervised pipeline: (1) Construction of a subset based on sampling of HHDs from RealPersonaChat; (2) Construction of role-model HCDs with validation by human evaluators; (3) Construction of a human-calibrated Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation benchmark for automatic adaptation; and (4) Adapation based on LLM evaluators’ consensus for HCD scaling. Experimental evaluations of adaptation effectiveness on Big5-HCD showed high approval rates and tolerance scores from human evaluators, confirming its reliability as a personality-annotated HCD benchmark for developing personality-aware HCD systems. The source code and data are available in: https://github.com/Drew19980118/Big5-HCD.git.
